notes: VAT 12.5% (VAT Act Chap. 75:06 s.7(1); IRD). Bullion coded 12.5: Schedules 1-2 of the official IRD consolidation were read in full and a text search for gold/jewellery found no matches - no investment-gold scheme. Silver 12.5/12.5. Duty null: the CARICOM CET gives HS 7108 only as a 0-5% band; TT's applied rate is unverified on an official TT page.

sources.name: Inland Revenue Division (ird.gov.tt) - Value Added Tax Act Chap. 75:06 (official consolidation, 2024), s.7(1)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: VAT is calculated at twelve and one-half per cent except for zero-rated supplies; Schedules 1-2 contain no gold item
sources.quote: The amount of the tax shall be calculated in accordance with this Act at the rate of twelve and one-half per cent or such other rate as the Minister by Order specifies, except in the case of an entry or a supply that is zero-rated.
